purgatorius.why: obscure, but a tiny primate ancestor implies the start of the mammal age

plesiadapis.why: 'among the first primate-like' places it early in the Cenozoic

eohippus-dawn-horse.why: 'dawn' and 'base of the family tree' say early, though not how early

icaronycteris-early-bat.why: 'early bat' suggests early Cenozoic but little else

pakicetus.why: a walking whale ancestor is clearly early in whale evolution

ambulocetus.why: transitional whale form, so early-middle whale evolution

andrewsarchus.why: giant hoofed carnivore skull gives no clear era

basilosaurus.why: vestigial legs imply a still-early whale

moeritherium.why: base of the family means early

paraceratherium.why: giant rhino relative could be many epochs

aegyptopithecus.why: near the root of apes implies mid-early Cenozoic

desmostylus.why: odd coastal grazer with no era cues

proconsul.why: earliest apes places it in the Miocene-ish span

merychippus.why: grazing horse with spreading grasslands is mid-Cenozoic

platybelodon.why: shovel-tusker elephant relative, no era cues

deinotherium.why: giant elephant relative, no era cues

livyatan.why: giant sperm whale with no era cues

thylacosmilus.why: sabre-tooth marsupial, easily confused with Smilodon era

sivatherium.why: giant giraffe relative, no era cues

megatherium.why: giant sloth suggests Ice Age megafauna

glyptodon.why: giant armadillo relative evokes Ice Age megafauna

arctodus.why: giant bear evokes Ice Age megafauna

cave-lion-big-cat.why: cave art and cold steppe point to the Ice Age

woolly-mammoth-steppe.why: mammoth is the iconic Ice Age animal

cave-bear.why: cave bear is an Ice Age symbol

dire-wolf-predator.why: dire wolf alongside sabre-tooth is Ice Age
